$comment: The single source of truth for the DSH Harness / dsh-pi-tui compatibility matrix.
One `matrix` row = one DSH range and the TUI line that is compatible with it;
`dshFrom` is the inclusive lower bound and the next row's `dshFrom` is the exclusive
upper bound, so the rows are contiguous by construction. A row without `tui` has no
released compatible TUI (the runtime notice offers the upgrade only). `versions`
lists the published DSH versions the row covers, oldest first.
`floor` is the catch-all below the oldest row. `current` describes the line this
checkout ships: the floor it imposes, the published DSH target and the recovery
wording. Consumed by src/startup.ts (inlined by the bundler) and, through
scripts/lib/dsh-compat.mjs, by the release tooling, the installation-doc gate and
